name: Beautiful Summer
summary:
Dive into Beautiful Summer, a captivating 2D adventure game where you'll navigate the joys and challenges of finding love at a vibrant recreation center. After a sudden breakup, your solo vacation turns into an unexpected opportunity to connect with a variety of captivating characters.

Explore the open world setting, filled with charming locations and intriguing storylines. Your mission? To win the hearts of the girls you meet. Engage in meaningful dialogue, discover their interests, and shower them with thoughtful gifts. Plan unforgettable dates and unlock their gratitude as you build bonds and experience the joys of summer romance.
